fixtureLabel: Synthetic UI responses only; not owner or market evidence
fact_spec: facts.unions[i] belongs to the i-th union of planCoverage(facts.context). COMPLETE: every minute of the union window is stored except missing (half-open open-time ranges) and, when present, missing_every_other (count single-minute gaps at first, first+2 minutes, ...). A stored minute is a timestamp at its close time (open time + 60000). TABLE_ABSENT: the market data table is absent. Coverage objects and envelopes are the output of buildCoverageSnapshot and projectPublicCoverage for that input; per-Bot bodies are composePerformanceResponse output.
